excerpt.zh:
你们如此竭尽全力而最终我也毫发无损……

真是浪费。我本对你们有更高的期望。不要把你的力量浪费在不会受到伤害的事物上。
excerpt.en:
You burned through so much just to leave me untouched...

Such a waste. I had hoped for more from you. Do not throw your strength away on what cannot be harmed.
